_description: MediaPipe 468-point face mesh landmark index sets for FitSkin skin ROI extraction. All indices reference the standard MediaPipe FaceMesh model (https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/face_landmarker). ROIs are computed as convex hulls over the listed indices, intersected with the tessellation skin mask. These indices are identical on all platforms (Python mediapipe, Swift Vision framework, Core ML).
_coordinate_system: Normalised [0,1] UV coordinates. x = right, y = down. Multiply by image width/height to get pixel coordinates.

_usage.swift: Use VNFaceObservation.landmarks.allPoints or ARFaceAnchor.geometry to obtain 468 3D landmarks, then project to 2D image coords and index into these arrays.
_usage.convex_hull: cv2.convexHull(pts) then cv2.fillConvexPoly — or equivalent on-device rasteriser.

cheek_left._description: Left cheek: nasolabial fold, cheekbone, zygomatic arch. Avoids shadow under nose and jaw line.

cheek_combined._description: Both cheeks merged into one convex hull — use when bilateral symmetry is assumed.

forehead._description: Forehead region between hairline and brow ridge. Good secondary sampling site: minimal shadow, no beard stubble.

exclusions._description: Regions to exclude from skin sampling. Build individual convex hulls for each, dilate by ~12% of inter-ocular distance, union them, then subtract from the skin mask.

face_oval._description: Full face outline for bounding the skin tessellation.

iod_reference._description: Inter-ocular distance (IOD) reference points. Used to set spatially-adaptive dilation radius for exclusion masks.

ecc_alignment._description: ECC (Enhanced Correlation Coefficient) warp applied to register the flash frame onto the no-flash frame before reflectance computation. Euclidean (rotation + translation) warp, 500 iterations, convergence 1e-6. Source: Evangelidis & Psarakis, IEEE TPAMI 2008.
ecc_alignment.input: grayscale luminance [0,1] of linear camera RGB

reflectance._description: Geometric-mean reflectance proxy. A = no-flash linear RGB, B = flash linear RGB (exposure-matched over skin). R = sqrt(A * B) element-wise, then scaled by per-participant exposure anchor s_exp.
